**Holy Peak** is a precision platformer about climbing a sacred mountain to ring a bell that has been silent for a thousand years.
Four chapters, 24 rooms, 12 hidden embers, and an original soundtrack. All art, music and sound are generated in code.

## Download

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (64-bit) | `HolyPeak-<version>-windows-x64.zip`: unzip, then run `HolyPeak\HolyPeak.exe` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon (M1 and newer) | `HolyPeak-<version>-macos-apple-silicon.zip` |
| macOS, Intel | `HolyPeak-<version>-macos-intel.zip` |
| Linux (64-bit) | `HolyPeak-<version>-linux-x64.tar.gz`: extract, then run `./HolyPeak/HolyPeak` |

Nothing needs installing: each download includes everything it needs.

**First launch notes**

- **Windows:** the game isn't code-signed, so SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Click *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
- **macOS:** the app isn't notarized. Right-click *Holy Peak.app*, choose *Open*, then *Open* again. If macOS still refuses, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "Holy Peak.app"` once in Terminal.
- **Everyone:** the soundtrack is generated in the background on first launch and cached afterwards.

## Controls

| Action | Keyboard | Gamepad |
|---|---|---|
| Move / aim | Arrow keys or WASD | Left stick / D-pad |
| Jump | C, Space or J | A |
| Dash | X, Shift or K | X, B, RB or RT |
| Pause | Esc or Enter | Start |
| Restart room | R | Back |
| Fullscreen | F11 | |

Assist options (game speed, infinite dash, invincibility) are in Options.
